Job Description:
Your job:

Are you passionate about delivering high-quality software and shaping the future of quality assurance in a growing organization? We’re looking for a proactive and detail-oriented mid-level Quality Assurance Engineer to help define, implement, and drive our testing strategy. You’ll play a key role in ensuring our web application is reliable, intuitive, and bug-free.

Your challenges:

What success looks like:

As a mid-level QA Engineer, your success will be defined by how well you strengthen our quality culture and enhance the robustness of our testing processes. You will:

Strengthen quality awareness in the organization by improving QA processes, tools, and methodologies
Estimate, prioritize, and plan testing efforts effectively
Conduct thorough functional, regression and exploratory testing of new and existing features
Verify bug fixes and ensure issues are resolved effectively without introducing regressions
Identify, document, and track defects using a bug tracking system
Write automated tests to increase test coverage and reliability using Playwright and TypeScript
Analyze automation test results, debug failures, and report findings to the team
Identify opportunities to streamline testing and help integrate automation into our CI/CD pipelines


You will:

Take ownership of writing and executing test cases and plans for new features and existing functionality
Perform manual testing while progressively increasing automation coverage
Lead efforts around regression testing to safeguard core functionality
Work cross-functionally with developers, designers, and product managers to advocate for quality at every stage of development
Stay up to date with the latest trends and best practices in software testing, and continuously improve your testing skills.


Who are you?

As a mid-level QA Engineer at Channable, you have a technical background and are also willing to understand the business needs of our end users. You are a passionate and driven individual who is eager to make a meaningful impact from day one:

At least 2 years of experience in software application testing
Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, principles, and best practices.
Experience with regression testing, functional testing, and exploratory testing
Experience with manual testing with a focus on frontend and UX
Experience using an automated test suite like Playwright or Cypress
Experience with tools for test documentation management and bug tracking systems
Experience with version control systems (git), familiarity with CI/CD concepts and tools
Basic understanding of web development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
Strong analytical and collaboration skills with attention to detail
Certifications like ISTQB are a strong plus


Some practical things we expect from you:

You are willing to work from our Utrecht office at least 2 days a week
You have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for the Netherlands. Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. 
You are available to work at least 32 hours per week


Who are we?

Channable was founded in 2014 in the heart of Utrecht. We are now a strong team of 320+ diverse individuals, and more than +40 nationalities.

Joining Channable means you’re looking for a bit more than just a job. Diverse as we are, we all share our love for growth, to help, to take ownership, and create an awesome journey together. Feel free to take a further look at who we are here and on our Instagram or LinkedIn! Wanna get to know us even more? Give our Culture Playbook a read.

What do we do?

Channable is a fast-growing B2B SaaS platform that offers a fully integrated way to market your products online. We empower marketers and online businesses to manage, scale, and optimize their marketing.

Want to read more about our development adventures? Then visit our inspiring tech blog: https://tech.channable.com/

And if this makes you enthusiastic, you can also take a look at some of our open-source work at https://github.com/channable to get a feeling of how we work together and what our code looks like.

What do we offer?

Gross monthly salary ranging from €3,200 to € 4,500 based on a 40-hour work week. This salary range reflects our career framework. Your final role level will be determined throughout the recruitment process, based on alignment with this framework.
8% holiday allowance - 8% of your yearly salary, which is paid together with your May salary.
Stock Appreciation Rights: eligible employees can financially profit from Channable’s success.
Annual L&D budget of €1000 to spend on anything you want to learn. You can take full advantage of this to grow professionally.
Saving for old age - we have a savings scheme for old age, which can accrue up to 5% of your monthly salary, or you can get an additional +2.5% to your monthly base salary.
Company-wide performance bonus, up to 10% of your annual salary, determined yearly by our founders based on financial planning and targets
Traveling to our office? No problem, we got you covered (NS Business Card, or €0,23 per km if you decide to use a different means of transport).
To work in a beautiful, historic and fully renovated office in the heart of Utrecht & with a flexible hybrid working policy of (minimum 2 days in the office).
Since you can work from home for 3 days a week, we will provide home office supplies.

26 vacation days + 2 reload days based on 40 hours.
We offer a 3-week-long workcation; and an additional 3 weeks, if you live as an expat in the Netherlands!
Are you going to become a parent? We think it is important that you spend time with your newborn. Enjoy 5 weeks of 100% paid partner leave.
We want you to feel good - please feel free to use our discounted Urban Sport Club subscription.
You have free & anonymous access to the OpenUp platform, and psychologists. This free service is also available to your family members.
Channaweekend (we will go abroad yearly for a long weekend with all the colleagues from all over the world).

On Fridays, we switch it up by ordering in tasty sandwiches and salads. Or, you can go to the city center to get the lunch of your choice.
Additional working conditions like massages, in-office bar (Channabar), parties, sports teams (even personal training sessions at our Channagym), video games, and many more!

Driving the future of software delivery at Rabobank

The new Agentic SDLC Hub is being built to accelerate how Rabobank designs, builds, tests and operates software with AI. We’re looking for engineers who combine technical excellence with adaptability, collaboration and a strong sense of ownership. These qualities are key to turning a bold vision into real change at scale.

Who we’re looking for

Tenacious engineers - passionate about software engineering, craftsmanship and relentless in their pursuit of impact. You are a polyglot by mindset: you care most about solving the problem and you move comfortably across tools, stacks and paradigms when the mission asks for it. You finish what you start, thrive in ambiguity, adapt when priorities shift and persist through technical complexity. Your work will influence how software gets built across Rabobank.

Your mindset matters

Are you an entrepreneurial builder whose ideas deserve to be heard? In the Hub, leadership actively backs fast innovation, removes roadblocks and creates room to experiment, learn and ship. This is a place for people who want to help define a new engineering model…not just participate in one.

What makes this role special

Work in a hub designed for builders who want to shape the next era of software engineering.
Freedom to experiment, learn and move fast—with visible leadership sponsorship.
A chance to build reusable capabilities that can scale across 1000+ squads.
We value curiosity, resilience, sharp engineering judgment and the courage to try new things.

A word of caution

We’re not just looking for GenAI enthusiasts—we’re looking for exceptional Engineers & Data Scientists. People who aim for excellence, thrive on solving tough challenges and know how to build from first principles. You should be excited by coding agents, but grounded in the engineering fundamentals needed to turn promise into production.

If your coding journey started before the rise of GenAI, you’ll feel right at home. We value engineers who understand the fundamentals, build across languages and frameworks, and bring side projects, prototypes or hobby builds that show real maker energy.

You and your job

We’re building AI-powered agents and reusable capabilities that will shape how Rabobank squads design, build, test and operate software. As an Agentic SDLC Engineer, you’ll play a key role in the new Agentic SDLC Hub, helping define what modern software delivery looks like at enterprise scale.

You’ll take ownership of complex GenAI and agent architectures, guide technical decisions, and help turn promising experiments into scalable building blocks that can be adopted far beyond a single team or use case.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who combines strong software fundamentals with deep interest in GenAI, coding agents and rapid experimentation — and who thrives in ambiguity, fast feedback loops and high-leverage delivery.

You’ll help set standards for agent design, system integration and developer experience, while continuously pushing for simplicity, speed and impact in a transformation that reaches the whole engineering organisation.

Practical examples

Designing and building AI assistants and agents that improve backlog refinement, code generation, code review, testing and broader software delivery workflows
Turning exploratory GenAI prototypes into robust, reusable building blocks that can scale across hundreds of teams
Define and implement ways to track the value delivered across the SDLC by these agents.
Coaching engineers on effective use of GenAI and coding agents in day-to-day software development
Making architectural trade-offs between speed, cost, reliability, governance and scalability
Improving developer experience by embedding agentic capabilities directly into existing tools, platforms and engineering workflows

Facts & figures

36 or 40 hours a week.
Mostly greenfield, with the opportunity to influence engineering standards from the ground up.
Approx. 43,822 Rabobank colleagues around the world.

Build production‑ready GenAI services platforms, with an eye towards portability
Lead solution design across APIs, event‑driven systems and AI workflows
Evaluate and select appropriate frameworks without over‑reliance on abstractions
Ensure performance, security and cost‑effectiveness of GenAI workloads

Collaborate with engineering, platform, product and business teams to translate opportunities into scalable technical capabilities.
Collaborate on the design and rollout of AI workflows, including prompt engineering, orchestration, tooling and reusable context.
Communicate technical concepts effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Act as a trusted advisor on agentic engineering strategy, platform scalability and operational excellence.

You are relentless in getting things done, you don’t give up, you adapt & find another way to complete your assignment. Lead by example in problem-solving, adaptability & continuous improvement.
Entrepreneurial mindset – you spot valuable opportunities, prototype fast and know how to build momentum around ideas that can change how teams work.
Excellent communication skills – able to simplify complex ideas and build trust across teams. Foster collaboration and alignment across engineering and business teams.
You combine technical depth with strong product intuition. You challenge solutions that are complex but low-impact, switch comfortably between languages and tools, and are comfortable making decisions with incomplete information — learning quickly through experimentation.

Proven end-to-end software engineering experience across the full lifecycle: from discovery and architecture through implementation, testing, deployment and production operations.
Strong hands-on expertise with cloud platforms combined with DevOps practices, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/Bicep), and an eye for portability across environments.

Excellent communication skills with the ability to mentor and lead technical teams, and to showcase your maker mindset through a hobby project, side build or prototype.
Agile experience (SCRUM or Kanban) and strong collaboration across cross-functional teams.

Curiosity and willingness to learn: An interest in enterprise technology, integrations, automation,

Oracle, and AI, with the confidence to ask questions and explore unfamiliar topics.

Analytical mindset: A structured approach to troubleshooting, attention to detail, and an interest in

understanding how systems and processes connect.

communication skills: Clear verbal and written communication in English and the ability to explain

As an AI Senior Systems Engineer, you will help shape the future of Systems Engineering at Philips by driving the application of Artificial Intelligence within Systems Engineering and Reliability, Availability, Maintainability and Safety Engineering (RAMS) practices.

You will identify opportunities where AI can enhance engineering activities, improve engineering productivity, and increase the quality, consistency, and traceability of engineering deliverables throughout the product development lifecycle. Identify, develop, and scale AI use cases for requirements engineering, system architecture, modelling, verification, validation, traceability, and engineering knowledge management.

Support engineering teams in evaluating and implementing AI-enabled engineering workflows, methods, and tools.
Coach and educate Systems Engineers, RAMS Engineers, Architects, and technical leaders on the opportunities, limitations, and best practices of applying AI within engineering environments.
Develop methodologies, standards, guidance, and reusable frameworks that enable the effective use of AI in Systems Engineering and RAMS Engineering.
Lead pilot projects and proof-of-concepts that demonstrate measurable engineering and business value.
Collaborate with engineering, software, data science, and AI experts to translate emerging AI capabilities into practical solutions.
Contribute to Philips-wide strategy and roadmap development for AI-enabled Systems Engineering, RAMS, and Digitalization of Innovation.
Foster a community of practice focused on innovation, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
Stay at the forefront of developments in AI, RAMS, Digital Engineering, and Systems Engineering, translating external innovations into practical applications for Philips.

Job Description:
Jouw baan

Ben jij een software engineer die verder kijkt dan alleen code? Heb je een praktische achtergrond of sterke affiniteit met de veehouderij en wil je jouw technische skills inzetten om de agrarische sector slimmer en duurzamer te maken? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Wat ga je doen?

Als software engineer werk je aan innovatieve digitale oplossingen voor de veehouderij. Denk aan simulatieprogramma’s om scenarioanalyses uit te voeren, applicaties voor dataverzameling en -analyse en managementsystemen voor veehouderijbedrijven (digital twins). Je vertaalt praktijkvragen naar slimme software en werkt nauw samen met collega’s uit zowel de IT als de agrarische praktijk.

Jouw Taken

ontwikkelen en onderhouden van software (bijvoorbeeld webapplicaties, dashboards of andere software instrumenten);
vertalen van praktijkbehoeften van onderzoekers en adviseurs naar technische oplossingen;
samenwerken met onderzoekers, adviseurs en eindgebruikers;
testen en verbeteren van bestaande systemen;
ontwikkelen en onderhouden van software (bijvoorbeeld webapplicaties, dashboards of andere software instrumenten).

Jouw team

Binnen de afdeling Animal Farming Systems ga je samenwerken met een onderzoeksteam van 35 zeer gemotiveerde projectleiders, onderzoekers en projectassistenten. We staan bekend om onze innovatieve en integrale aanpak in het ontwerpen en evalueren van de duurzaamheid van dierhouderijsystemen. Je werkt samen met collega’s uit je eigen team en collega’s van andere afdelingen of onderzoeksinstituten in projectteamverband.

Hier ga je werken 

Je gaat werken op de groenste en meest innovatieve campus van Nederland, en op een universiteit die 20 keer is gekozen tot de “beste universiteit” van Nederland en ook wereldwijd gezien wordt als de beste universiteit op het agrofooddomein.

Jouw kwaliteiten

Jij hebt een analytisch denkvermogen en een oplossingsgerichte mindset. Daarnaast beschik je over goede communicatieve vaardigheden en een proactieve houding.

Ook beschik jij over: 

een afgeronde HBO-opleiding gericht op informatica, dierhouderij of agrarisch ondernemerschap;
ervaring in het ontwikkelen van software met bijvoorbeeld C# of Python;
affiniteit met en interesse in de veehouderijsector.

In onze internationale werkomgeving wordt steeds meer in het Engels gecommuniceerd. Voor deze functie gaat het om taalniveau C1. Heb je dit niveau nog niet, dan helpen wij je vanzelfsprekend en kun je terecht bij ons taalcentrum Wageningen in’to Language.

Je ziet dat er voldoende uitdagingen voor jou liggen. Deze uitdagingen kunnen ook als ontwikkelmogelijkheden gezien worden. Mocht jij dus nog niet het track-record hebben dat in de vacature wordt gevraagd, maar wél solide werkervaring hebben, dan willen we jou ook graag uitnodigen om te solliciteren.

Wij bieden

Als het gaat om arbeidsvoorwaarden zit je goed bij Wageningen University & Research. Highlights uit onze CAO zijn: 

werktijden die in overleg kunnen worden vastgesteld, zodat een optimale balans tussen werk en privé mogelijk is; 
sabbatical leave, studieverlof en deels betaald ouderschapverlof; 
er is veel aandacht voor vitaliteit en je kan, tegen een aantrekkelijk tarief, gebruik maken van de op de campus aanwezige sportfaciliteiten; 
een structurele eindejaarsuitkering van 8,3%; 
uitstekende pensioenregeling via ABP. 

Bij deze uitstekende secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden hoort natuurlijk ook een passend salaris. Wij bieden afhankelijk van je ervaring, een marktconform salaris van minimaal € 3.381,- tot maximaal € 5.132,- bij een volledige werkweek van 36 uur conform CAO Wageningen Research (schaal 8-9). De inschaling is afhankelijk van relevante ervaring en opleidingsachtergrond. Voor deze rol is een aanstelling van 32 tot 36 uur bespreekbaar. Als het gaat om je contract bieden we in eerste instantie een jaarcontract aan dat – als dat mogelijk is binnen de (bedrijfseconomische) organisatieomstandigheden - bij goed functioneren verlengd kan worden.

We stimuleren ontwikkeling en mobiliteit binnen onze organisatie. In ons werving- en selectiebeleid lees je welke voorwaarden specifiek voor jou gelden als (oud) medewerker. Heb je hierover vragen, dan helpen we je graag.

Je werkt op de groenste en meest innovatieve campus van Nederland, in een internationale en open werksfeer.

Belangrijke informatie

Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Frank Gort, hoofd afdeling Dierhouderijsystemen, via telefoonnummer: 06-81028847 of via e-mail: frank.gort@wur.nl (mailto:frank.gort@wur.nl).

Vragen over de procedure? Neem contact op met Dax Teunissen, corporate recruiter, via e-mail: recruitment.asg@wur.nl (mailto:recruitment.asg@wur.nl).

Solliciteren?

Klik op de sollicitatiebutton bij de vacature op onze website. Alleen sollicitaties via onze website worden in behandeling genomen.

Reageren kan tot en met zondag 27 september 2026. Bij voorkeur solliciteren interne kandidaten vóór 1 augustus 2026.

Wij beoordelen binnengekomen reacties doorlopend, ook vóór de sluitingsdatum. Daarom kan het voorkomen dat de vacature eerder wordt gesloten dan vermeld.

Welkom, veilig en gewaardeerd

Wageningen University & Research (WUR) hecht grote waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie. Dit omdat we geloven dat verschillende inzichten leiden tot innovatieve oplossingen. We creëren daarom een werkomgeving waar iedereen zich welkom, veilig en gewaardeerd voelt, ongeacht achtergrond, identiteit of ervaring. Samen bouwen we aan een cultuur waarin ieders unieke bijdrage bijdraagt aan het succes van onze organisatie.

Wij zijn

De missie van Wageningen University & Research is ‘To explore the potential of nature to improve the quality of life’. Binnen Wageningen University & Research bundelen Wageningen University en gespecialiseerde onderzoeksinstituten van Stichting Wageningen Research hun krachten om bij te dragen aan de oplossing van belangrijke vragen in het domein van gezonde voeding en leefomgeving. Met ongeveer 30 vestigingen, 7.600 medewerkers (6.700 fte) en 13.100 studenten en ruim 150.000 Leven Lang Leren-deelnemers behoort Wageningen University & Research wereldwijd tot de aansprekende kennisinstellingen binnen haar domein. De integrale benadering van de vraagstukken en de samenwerking tussen verschillende disciplines vormen het hart van de unieke Wageningen aanpak.

Deze punten geven onze medewerkers aan als goede redenen om te komen werken bij WUR: lees de 6 redenen om te komen werken bij WUR (https://www.wur.nl/nl/Werken-bij/Daarom-werken-bij-Wageningen-University-Research.htm)
